Name: Orca
Description: Control Orca worktrees, tabs, sidebars and scrolling with D200X keys and dials.

Actions.Name: Open Orca
Actions.Tooltip: Open Orca or bring it to the front.

Actions.Name: Previous worktree
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate Orca. Wrap around at either end.

Actions.Name: Next worktree
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate Orca. Wrap around at either end.

Actions.Name: Previous tab (all types)
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate Orca. Wrap around at either end.

Actions.Name: Next tab (all types)
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate Orca. Wrap around at either end.

Actions.Name: Worktree navigation dial
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate Orca. Wrap around at either end.

Actions.Name: Tab navigation dial (all types)
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate Orca. Wrap around at either end.

Actions.Name: Confirm (Enter)
Actions.Tooltip: Send Enter to the current focus. This may submit composer text.

Actions.Name: Cancel (Esc)
Actions.Tooltip: Send Esc to the current focus. Orca may stop work, cancel, or close a menu.

Actions.Name: Dictation
Actions.Tooltip: Cmd+E / Ctrl+E. Uses existing Orca voice settings.

Actions.Name: New Agent Tab
Actions.Tooltip: macOS: Cmd+Option+T. No Windows default shortcut.

Actions.Name: Mouse wheel
Actions.Tooltip: Left=up, right=down. Scrolls at the mouse pointer without activating Orca.

Detail: Independent Ulanzi Studio plugin: launch Orca, navigate worktrees and all tabs, toggle sidebars, Enter/Esc, dictation, new agent tab and 3 dial actions. Tested: D200X, Apple Silicon, macOS 27.0.1, Orca 1.4.258, Studio 3.4.8. Install Orca first. Import the profile separately; set its app association manually. Enter may send text; Esc follows focus; scrolling follows the pointer. Windows untested; Intel Mac wheel unsupported. Not an official Orca or Ulanzi product. Windows support is available; New Agent Tab is macOS-only.
